{{Top|leg}}
'''Adrenaline''' was a drug that naturally occurred in the body of many [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was commonly found among the standard contents of a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]].

==Behind the scenes==
In real life, [[Wikipedia:Adrenaline|adrenaline]], also known as epinephrine, is a hormone and neurotransmitter generally associated with the [[Wikipedia:Fight-or-flight response|fight-or-flight response]] of the [[Wikipedia:Sympathetic nervous system|sympathetic nervous system]].
